text:
Maria (CS): Quick capture from ACME onboarding call — three asks + a pain note. Customer called per-route cost visibility a blocker and said retries are causing duplicate charges. They also asked for a webhook for batch export completion instead of polling.

Maria (CS): Verbatim asks they want captured for triage:
```
1) Show per-route cost by user/org in Console (breakdown + export CSV)
2) Retries currently double-bill on 5xx; want idempotency token or billing-safe retries
3) Webhook when batch exports finish (avoid polling)
```
They said: "If we can't see cost per-route, it's a deal-breaker for rollout" — renewal risk flagged. @Sam (Product) can you advise priority? @Alex (Eng) any short-term mitigations? :eyes:

Sam (Product): Thanks Maria — can you confirm this is for hosted accounts only or also Dedicated? Also, do they have example request IDs/logs that show duplicate billing? If yes paste here.

Maria (CS): It's Hosted (account id: acct_37X). Customer pasted a failing request trace in chat — sample curl below showing retry loop: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -d '{"input":"..."}'
# client retries on 502, same idempotency header not present
```
They didn't include idempotency header.

Priya (CS): I'm adding this to the CS tracker (Airtable row: https://airtable.com/shrExample/rec1729) and tagging "renewal-risk". I'll message ACME with a temporary workaround: disable client-side automatic retries and let us investigate. :white_check_mark:

Alex (Eng): Quick notes from infra: we can do two things — (1) treat 5xx as non-billable for retried tokens (short config change) as an interim (~3 days), (2) support idempotency header properly (requires API surface + docs, 2-week sprint). Webhook for batch exports is an independent story (est estimate 3 sprints).

Jordan (CSE): I'll add a one-pager to enablement that outlines the workaround + how to set idempotency headers (once shipped). Also can connect ACME to Solutions Eng for a short call. :thumbsup:

Sam (Product): Proposed next steps: 1) Priya confirm customer ok with temporary workaround 2) Alex scope PR for non-billable retry change (pref pref release) 3) PM to slot idempotency header in next sprint and prioritize webhook as a separate epic. Can @Alex confirm scope and risk?

Alex (Eng): Confirmed. I'll create a minimal RFC and tag it "billing-safety" in our repo. Low-risk change for interim but needs monitoring.

Maria (CS): Perfect — I'll update ACME and mark as "at-risk -> mitigation pending" in Salesforce. Will follow up once customer acknowledges workaround. Thanks all. :pray:
